digest.component_or_area: Cloud adapter (Jira Cloud transport and reconciler)
propositions: Cloud transport members lack enumerated 429-sweep coverage across four distinct retry behaviors (ACLI subprocess backoff, pooled REST no-retry, bare urlopen no-retry, dispatch-wrapper retry), each verified at its own boundary, with per-member duplicate-write safety assessment recorded in repo artifact.
Cloud lacks config-validation tier tests for non-HTTPS base URL rejection, missing credential failure loudness, and malformed config propagation that DC gained from epic e369 hardening.

Cloud probe hardcodes RESOLVED_STATUS_NAMES instead of threading runtime-configurable resolved_statuses from settings as DC does, requiring decision on whether non-standard workflow state names warrant a runtime config hook.

DC user-search degradation is unasserted: _USER_SEARCH_METHODS aliases missing on DC shape should degrade to string-match rather than raise, and that degradation must be pinned to prevent accidental rename misses.
